# The Four Keys to Bird ID

- **Size and Shape**
- **Color pattern**
- Habitat
- Behavior

# Labs 4-11

- Learn **Order** ("-formes"), **Family** ("-dae"), **Common Name** ("snow goose")
- parentheses indicates plumage morph you must recognize
- page numbers correspond to National Geographic 7th Ed. field guide
- you most also learn vocalizations for **bolded** species names 

\begin{figure}
\includegraphics[width = 0.9\linewidth]{images/lab_manual.png}
\end{figure}

# Anseriformes: Anatidae: Geese

- White / gray (*Anser*) or black (*Branta*)
- Similar species distinguished by bill size

\end{figure}
